The United States Space Force (USSF) at Joint Base San Antonio is searching for a Project Engineer for SYD 81 (NH-0801-03, GS-12/13).

Description: This position is a Systems Engineer working in the Space Force Personnel Data Management office responsible for developing two Space Force Wide programs - a new Human Resources IT program and Continuous Fitness Assessment Wearables (CFAW) program to utilize fitness devices for PT testing.

This office develops and maintains the technical baseline and systems architecture for enterprise capabilities in support of the Space Force and mission partners. This includes engineering support for HR IT and CFAW.

This position provides critical engineering support, which ensures technical integration and synchronization across SYD 81, executes systems engineering processes in support of HR IT, CFA, and SYD 81, provides data integration guidance, and evaluates contractor technical performance in SYD 81.

This office is also responsible for creating, coordinating, and synchronizing technical requirements, test strategies, and other official engineering documentation through SYD 81 staff functions for current and future HR IT and CFAW operations and activities.

Will lead a mixed team of approximately 5 Government civilian, military, and support contractors. Ideal Candidate: Ideal candidate would possess years of experience in systems or software engineering. Possessing a background in enterprise IT environments, agile business capability delivery, and system integration is highly desired.

Knowledge of Defense Business Systems (DBS), data architectures, test & evaluation processes, and APDP Practitioner Certification in Engineering/Technical Management is also highly desired. Must be able to lead a team of Government civilian, military, and support contractors.

Must be an effective communicator, able to receive, interpret, and communicate technical information from senior leadership to the rest of the organization. Key Skills and Abilities: 1.

Knowledge of a wide range of advanced multidisciplinary professional engineering concepts, principles, practices, standards, methods, and techniques to apply experimental theories and new developments to problems not susceptible to treatment by accepted methods, and to plan and execute specialized programs of marked difficulty, responsibility, and significance. 2.

Knowledge of the mission, roles, functions, organizational structure, and operation of the DoD, and organizations that govern, interface with, and/or influence systems acquisition, development, and/or sustainment; and knowledge of planning, programming, and budgeting cycles, financial systems, and restrictions on expenditure of funds. 3.

Knowledge of and skill in evaluating state-of-the-art and advancements in theory, application, technology, and policy affecting systems being developed, and in planning, organizing, and directing the functions and staff in critical aspects of development, production, and/or support of systems, subsystems, or equipment. 4.

Knowledge of safety, security, and operational engineering procedures. 5. Skill in establishing and maintaining effective relationships, building consensus and coalitions, negotiating, and resolving conflicts with a variety of individuals and organizations as well as communicating effectively, both orally and in writing.

##### Descrizione del lavoro: #####
We are looking for a technically skilled professional with a strong background in systems administration and infrastructure operations to join our **Workload Automation and Managed File Transfer (MFT)** team.
The role combines daily operational activities with engineering and project work. The successful candidate will be responsible for the administration, support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of enterprise scheduling and file transfer platforms, while also contributing to upgrades, migrations, integrations, and technology evolution initiatives.
Working closely with Infrastructure, Application, Security, and external vendor teams, the candidate will progressively take ownership of the managed platforms and related technical initiatives.

* Manage and support enterprise Scheduling and Managed File Transfer platforms.
* Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot jobs, workflows, batch processes, and file transfer flows.
* Handle incidents, perform root cause analysis, and provide technical support to internal teams.
* Administer secure communication technologies, including SFTP, HTTPS, SSH, TLS, certificates, and PGP/GPG.
* Develop automation solutions, scripts, and integrations to improve operational efficiency.
* Participate in platform upgrades, migrations, and implementation of new solutions.
* Maintain technical documentation and support internal and external audits.
* Ensure compliance with security standards and applicable regulatory requirements.

* Experience in System Engineering, Infrastructure Operations, Automation, Middleware, or Application Support environments.
* Good knowledge of Linux and Windows systems.
* Experience with Workload Automation solutions (Automic/UC4, Control-M, IBM Workload Scheduler, or similar) and/or Managed File Transfer platforms (Primeur Data One, GoAnywhere, Axway, IBM Sterling, MOVEit, or equivalent).
* Knowledge of secure file transfer and encryption technologies (SFTP, FTPS, HTTPS, SSH, TLS, PGP/GPG).
* Scripting experience with Bash, Python, PowerShell, or similar technologies.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Understanding of networking concepts and system integration principles.
Experience with Broadcom Automic Automation (UC4), Primeur Data One, REST APIs, SQL, Jenkins, Ansible, Splunk, Dynatrace, Jira, and Confluence will be considered a plus.
## Personal Skills ##
* Proactive and hands-on approach.
* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Excellent problem-solving capabilities.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.
* Attention to detail and commitment to continuous improvement.
* Professional proficiency in Italian and English

s.h: Ce qui rend ton quotidien passionnant
s.t:
Installer et utiliser Windows, ça prend quelques minutes. La mise en place d'un logiciel de gestion est déjà plus complexe. Tu aides les PME suisses à adapter le logiciel Abacus à leurs besoins et à leurs processus.
Après une introduction soignée et personnalisée, tu prends la responsabilité de « ton » projet ou mandat client. Tu peux alors compter sur le soutien de tes collègues.
Avec les clients, tu analyses leurs processus, tu recueilles leurs besoins et tu les documentes.
Tu mets ensuite en place la solution logicielle sur mesure chez le client. Cela dure généralement plusieurs semaines et tu travailles souvent directement sur quoi enrichir encore ton quotidien.
Ton portefeuille de tâches comprend également l'organisation et l'animation d'ateliers et de formations pour les utilisateurs de tes clients.

Tu n'as pas forcément besoin d'être déjà un pro du logiciel, mais un grand intérêt pour l'informatique est aussi important que la fascination pour la digitalisation et les opportunités qu'elle offre pour l'optimisation des processus.
Tu saisis rapidement les liens entre les choses, tu aimes apprendre de nouvelles choses et l'ambition te gagne dès qu'il s'agit de comprendre le métier de tes clients et de leur proposer de bonnes solutions.
Ce que nous imaginons dans ton bagage de formation ? Pas si simple, car de nombreux chemins mènent jusqu'à nous. Une formation commerciale ou technique complétée par un perfectionnement en gestion d'entreprise de niveau HES/ES ou par un brevet fédéral a de bonnes chances d'aboutir, que ce soit déjà terminé ou en passe de l'être.
Des connaissances de base en anglais et/ou en allemand sont idéalement nécessaires pour évoluer aisément dans notre environnement.
Si tu as déjà été en contact avec Abacus ou d'autres systèmes ERP, tant mieux. Peut\-être au service commercial interne. Ou dans la gestion des stocks. Ou dans un service financier. Mais ce n'est pas une condition.
Tes futurs collègues attendent avec impatience le renfort d'une personne simple et sympa, qui aime rire, y compris d'elle\-même. Et oui, il y a du pain sur la planche : il faudra savoir « foncer tête baissée ». Ça vaut le coup, promis.

Un poste exigeant mais passionnant, dans lequel nous te formons soigneusement sur place. Et une fois à l'aise, de très belles perspectives d'évolution.

Dans notre domaine, nous comptons parmi les grands acteurs et sommes reconnus pour notre grande qualité. Rien d'étonnant à ce que nous soyons régulièrement distingués comme partenaire d’intégration exceptionnel.

Nous aurions encore tellement à raconter. Ce qui rend ton job chez nous passionnant, par exemple. Qui nous sommes et comment nous fonctionnons. Alors n'hésite pas et fais\-toi ta propre idée.
